$comment: The Wildlife photography collection. Files are Anya's final selection in public/assets/wildlife-photography/ and are served exactly as supplied (never resized, re-encoded or cropped). The folder a photograph sits in sets its visual weight: main-gallery → larger placements, secondary-gallery → smaller ones; the page never names these groups. `hero` opens the page; `homepage` is also the homepage's preview. Copy (Anya's): `title` names the photograph everywhere; `hover` is the short caption shown on hover and keyboard focus; `caption` is the longer caption shown in the opened, larger view (on every screen size); `alt` describes what the image shows for screen readers. `rows` is the viewing sequence: each row's photographs share one height and keep their own proportions; a nested list is a column of photographs stacked within the row (together exactly as tall as the row). After adding or replacing a file, run `node scripts/build-wildlife-photos.mjs` (it only reads the files: dimensions and a loading colour).

lion-on-the-road.title: The road ahead
lion-on-the-road.hover: A young lioness at Karongwe, on a day of unexpected turns.
lion-on-the-road.caption: Photographed at Karongwe Private Game Reserve in 2024, after the reserve team darted a three-year-old lioness who had left the reserve. She was also due to be moved for breeding management: she had reached sexual maturity, and the only male in the reserve’s pride was her father.
lion-on-the-road.alt: A young lioness walking away down a dusty dirt road lined with bare trees, under a hazy pink sky.

jacana.title: African jacana
jacana.hover: A small bird, a still reflection.
jacana.caption: An African jacana walking across the water’s surface, reflected among the lily pads.
jacana.alt: An African jacana, chestnut-bodied with long toes, walking across lily pads, reflected in dark blue water.

golden-hour-lion.title: Casper
golden-hour-lion.hover: A quiet moment with Kruger’s white lion.
golden-hour-lion.caption: Casper, a rare white lion in Kruger National Park. Born in 2014, he was around ten years old when I photographed him in 2024.
golden-hour-lion.alt: A white lion with a pale mane lying in tall golden grass, looking towards the camera.

elephant-among-trees.title: An uninvited visitor
elephant-among-trees.hover: An elephant stopped by our research base—and helped itself.
elephant-among-trees.caption: Our base at Karongwe was an old farmhouse. A group of elephants came through, broke the water pipes, ate, and then carried on. This was one of them.
elephant-among-trees.alt: An elephant seen from below, its trunk stretched straight up into the leaves of a tree, tusks showing.

collared-cheetah.title: Taba
collared-cheetah.hover: The older of Karongwe’s two female cheetahs.
collared-cheetah.caption: Taba, the older of the reserve’s two female cheetahs, sitting beside a sandy track at Karongwe.
collared-cheetah.alt: Taba, a cheetah wearing a tracking collar, sitting upright in dry grass at the edge of a sandy track.

walking-leopard.title: Looking for her cubs
walking-leopard.hover: A female leopard searching for her cubs.
walking-leopard.caption: I photographed her as she was looking for her cubs; around this moment, she began calling out for them.
walking-leopard.alt: A female leopard walking across open, bare ground in front of a tangle of dry bushes.

sunset-giraffes.title: Last light
sunset-giraffes.hover: Two giraffes against a golden sky.
sunset-giraffes.caption: Two giraffes silhouetted between the trees as the light faded.
sunset-giraffes.alt: Two giraffes in black silhouette between dark trees, against an orange sky.

african-fish-eagle.title: African fish eagle
african-fish-eagle.hover: A familiar silhouette against the evening sky.
african-fish-eagle.caption: An African fish eagle perched on a bare branch as the sky turned pink.
african-fish-eagle.alt: An African fish eagle, white head and dark body, perched on a curving bare branch against a pale pink sky.

twilight-hippos.title: An evening by the water
twilight-hippos.hover: Hippos at dusk, not far from our research base.
twilight-hippos.caption: I spotted these hippos on an evening walk near our research base at Karongwe. Only their heads broke the surface of the water.
twilight-hippos.alt: Two hippos with only their heads above still water that reflects a pink and purple sky, a dark treeline behind.

hornbill.title: Southern yellow-billed hornbill
hornbill.hover: A flash of yellow among the branches.
hornbill.caption: A southern yellow-billed hornbill perched among the branches.
hornbill.alt: A southern yellow-billed hornbill, its large curved yellow bill catching the light, perched among sunlit branches and leaves against a blue sky.

perched-raptor.title: Tawny eagle
perched-raptor.caption: Perched high on a bare branch, with nothing but sky around it.
perched-raptor.alt: A tawny eagle perched at the top of a bare, dead branch against a clear blue sky.

feeding-giraffe.title: A reach into the branches
feeding-giraffe.hover: A giraffe feeding among the thorns.
feeding-giraffe.caption: A giraffe reaching into a thorny bush for a meal.
feeding-giraffe.alt: A giraffe's head and neck reaching over the top of a thorny bush to feed, against a blue sky.

elephant-family.title: Side by side
elephant-family.hover: An elephant and calf feeding together.
elephant-family.caption: An adult elephant and a calf, close together as they fed.
elephant-family.alt: Adult elephants standing together in dry bush, with young elephants sheltering in the shade beneath them.

elephant-profile.title: Up close
elephant-profile.caption: A closer look at an elephant’s ear, eye, and tusk.
elephant-profile.alt: A close, upright view of an elephant in profile: its ear, eye and long tusk, against green bush.
